from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of the Cash and Cash Equivalents value from a single financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The legal name of the company filing the document")
    reporting_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the financial statements cover or are as of")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used in the document for the cash figure")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the cash amount")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt showing the value and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_records: list[CompanyCashRecord]
